svg.aria-label: Claude Code with the Christmas theme: snow falls over the conversation, the pointer rests on a bell in the garland above the prompt and it rings Jingle Bells, lights chase along the garland and a reindeer sleigh glides along the snowbank below

g.text: add a dark mode toggle to the settings page
I'll add a toggle under Appearance and remember the choice.
Done. The toggle sits under Appearance and is saved to localStorage.
